forms: истекнем, истекну; past истекао; impf. истицати

examples.en: Time has run out.
My passport expired last month.
We quickly got used to the new city.
We have to adjust the plan.
I'm afraid of spiders.
There's a big spider in the corner of the room.

tips: On a «Паук носи» road sign, паук means a tow truck: that is what people call the vehicle that hauls away wrongly parked cars.
Colloquially паук is also a tow truck: «Однео ми је паук кола» - a tow truck took my car away.

examples.en: Why are you avoiding me?
Avoid fatty food.
You have very nice handwriting.
He sent the manuscript to the publisher.
It was a desperate attempt.
She desperately needs help.
I feel a connection with you.

examples.sr: Не видим [пове́заност] између та два случаја.
examples.en: I don't see a connection between those two cases.
He works in a state institution.
The hospital is a public institution.
Social media takes up a lot of time.
Marko is a very sociable guy.

tips: Also «sociable»: друштвен човек - a sociable person; друштвене мреже - social media.

examples.en: Gravity keeps us on the ground.
Gravity is weaker on the Moon.
Throw the trash in the dumpster.
The ship carries hundreds of containers.
Dogs don't attack without a reason.
Why do you keep attacking me?

tips: Colloquially also «to pick on, to hassle»: «престани да ме нападаш!» - stop picking on me.

examples.en: That man is a plain swindler.
Her ex-boyfriend was cheating on her.

note: feminine, but also used of a man: он је варалица

examples.en: Lightning struck the tree.
He ran off as fast as lightning.
We found shelter in a cave.
This house is my haven.
In summer we love boiled corn.
Behind the house there is a cornfield.

tips: Masculine gender: сладак кукуруз (sweet corn).

examples.en: The police must establish the facts.
The doctors have not yet determined the cause of death.
He hugged me tightly.
A strong wind blew all night.
Remember this formula for the exam.
There is no formula for happiness.
Who was behind the wheel?
Keep both hands on the steering wheel.
We did everything legally.
Is that even legal?
The turtle hid in its shell.
You're as slow as a turtle!
My hard drive is full.
He threw the discus very far.
The kids are jumping on the bed.
Don't jump into the water here!
The sun gives us light and warmth.
I felt the warmth of her hand.
An eagle is flying high above the mountain.
We saw two eagles.
Departure is at eight o'clock.
Check your passport before you leave.
You're getting on my nerves!
He has a damaged nerve in his leg.

note: «ићи на живце» - to get on someone's nerves
tips: «Погодити у живац» - to hit a nerve. «Попустили су му живци» - his nerves gave out, he snapped.

examples.en: The witch cast a curse on the king.
Do you believe in curses?
The nurse couldn't find a vein.
Blood flows through the veins to the heart.
His grandfather was killed at the front.
A cold front is coming tomorrow.
He turned himself in to the police voluntarily.
Did you come of your own free will?
He is a malicious and dangerous man.
He had a malignant disease.

examples.sr: Овај ауто има [по̏гон] на сва четири точка.
examples.en: This car has four-wheel drive.

examples.sr: Тридесет година је радио у [по̀гону] фабрике.
examples.en: He worked for thirty years in the production plant of the factory.
Powdered milk keeps longer.

examples.sr: Од старе куће остали су само [пра̑х] и пепео.
examples.en: Only dust and ashes were left of the old house.

tips: Powder: «прах за веш» - laundry detergent. For dust, the usual word is прашина.

examples.en: I clean the apartment every Saturday.
Who's going to clean this up now?
Her touch calmed me down.
You've lost touch with reality.
After the trip I'm completely exhausted.
She was worn out from work.

tips: Исцрпљен means exhausted: «исцрпљен сам»; исцрпан means exhaustive (of an answer). Do not confuse them.

examples.en: I appreciate your honesty.
Sincerity matters most in a relationship.
He only drinks vodka.
They each had a small glass of vodka.
It's pointless for us to argue.
All of this seems senseless to me.

examples.sr: У [про̀теклих] пет година много се променило.
examples.en: A lot has changed in the past five years.
It rained all the time last week.
The phone keeps ringing.
She talks about him constantly.
Thanks for the compliment.

examples.sr: То је био [комплѝмент], а не увреда.
examples.en: That was a compliment, not an insult.
Give me just a little piece of cake.
The plate broke into pieces.
The police are still looking for the attacker.
He is the best forward on the team.
Grandpa loves fishing very much.
We're going fishing tomorrow.
That's just his way.
What's the deal with that now?

tips: Not only «style»: also a joke («добар ти је фазон»), a filler like «kind of» («фазон око десет») and a mood («у фазону сам да ништа не радим»). Colloquial.
All-purpose slang: у чему је фазон? - what's the deal; није мој фазон - not my thing; у фазону - like, sort of: «рекао је нешто у фазону...»

examples.en: You're as pale as a corpse.
They found a dead body in the basement.
The horses are in the stable.
Your room looks like a pigsty!
He is the sole heir to the fortune.
The king has no heir.
Our team reached the final.

examples.sr: У [фѝналу] је изгубио од младог Шпанца.
examples.en: In the final he lost to a young Spaniard.
Give me a kilogram of apples.
I lost five kilograms.

tips: After 2-4 the genitive singular is used: два килограма, три килограма (not «килограми»). Colloquially «кило» is common: пет кила.

examples.en: You were a naughty boy.
The cat has been naughty again.

related.en: to be good, to be of use

examples.sr: Фирма је ове године имала велики [про̀фӣт].
examples.en: The company made a big profit this year.
He only thinks about profit.
We want to expand the business.
The news spread quickly through the city.
The dog has a chip under its skin.
The new phone has a faster chip.
The firefighters arrived quickly.

examples.sr: Као дете сам хтео да будем [ватрога́сац].
examples.en: As a child I wanted to be a firefighter.
Don't translate it word for word.
I was literally on the brink of death.
This round is on me!
The band is going on tour around Europe.

note: «тура пића» - a round of drinks for everyone
tips: Also a short excursion, usually with a guide: «бесплатне туре у центру града» - free tours of the city center.

examples.sr: Тај [прева̀рант] ми је узео сав новац.
examples.en: That crook took all my money.
It turned out that he was a fraudster.
That is truly unbelievable.
Did you really mean that?

note: bookish; in conversation «стварно» is more common
tips: In the church greeting «Христос се роди - Ваистину се роди» the word «ваистину» is Church Slavonic. In ordinary speech only уистину is used.

examples.en: The kids are laughing at the clown.
Stop acting like a clown.
They agreed on a prisoner exchange.
Sharing experiences is always useful.
Grandpa is a little hard of hearing.

examples.sr: Јеси ли [глу̑в]? Зовем те већ пет минута!
examples.en: Are you deaf? I've been calling you for five minutes!
She is an exceptional woman.
This is an exceptional case.
The workers joined the union.
He runs a criminal syndicate.
He has trouble breathing.
The patient's breathing is normal now.
That was an excellent concert.
The government called an extraordinary session.
The female guards the young.
Is this a male or a female?

tips: Together with «мужјак» it fits any animal, pets included: «Твој љубимац је женка или мужјак?» - is your pet female or male?

examples.en: At the airport they separated us.

examples.sr: Можеш ли да [одво̀јиш] пет минута за мене?
examples.en: Can you spare five minutes for me?
After the breakup of Yugoslavia many people left.
Their marriage is on the verge of collapse.
I go to the gym three times a week.
See you later at the gym.

tips: Три пута недељно идем у теретану - I go to the gym three times a week. Тренирам у теретани - I work out at the gym. Радим јутарњу гимнастику - I do my morning exercises.

examples.en: I filed a complaint with the director.
The lawyer will appeal the verdict.
At night you can hear frogs in the pond.

examples.sr: Пољубила је [жа̏бу], али није добила принца.
examples.en: She kissed a frog, but didn't get a prince.

tips: Said affectionately or jokingly: «жаба једна» - you little frog. Жаба covers both frog and toad.

examples.en: I got these tickets for free.

examples.sr: Све смо спремили [џа̏бе̄], нико није дошао.
examples.en: We prepared everything for nothing - nobody came.

note: colloquial; means both «for free» and «in vain»
tips: The variants «за џабе» and «џаба» all mean «for free, almost free». Related saying: «Нека стоји, хлеба не једе» - let it sit there, it does no harm.
«Џабе си кречио» (literally «you whitewashed the walls in vain») - an expression for wasted effort: all for nothing.
Џабе means free (also: гратис, на поклон) and in vain: «Али џабе!» - but all to no avail. Багатела - a trifle, a small thing.

examples.en: He finished university last year.
During her studies she worked in a cafe.
I finally got my diploma.
He has a law degree.
The invasion began at dawn.
This summer we have a real invasion of mosquitoes.
Look around, there's nobody here.
He wandered around aimlessly.
Grandma looks after her grandson every day.

examples.sr: Деда се игра са [у̀нуцима] у парку.
examples.en: Grandpa plays with his grandchildren in the park.
Everything took place in the strictest secrecy.
We must keep the project secret.
Trust your instinct.
The maternal instinct is very strong.
On Sunday we went to the gallery.
The exhibition is in the new gallery.
What do you advise me to do?
The doctor advised him to rest.
You have to accept reality.
His dream became reality.
In autumn leaves fall from the trees.
The kids are playing in the leaves.

note: collective, takes a singular verb: лишће пада
tips: Collective noun: the verb is singular (лишће је суво). Лишће is leaves as a mass, while «листови» are individual leaves.

examples.en: Our team won the cup.
The cup final is played on Saturday.
The view from the mountain is magnificent.
It was a magnificent celebration.
The car got stuck in the swamp.
We crossed the marsh on foot.
The director is in his office.
The prime minister introduced the new cabinet.
Your brother is very charming.
I met a charming girl.
I was born in July.
At the beginning of July we go to the seaside.
I will always support you.
My family supported me in everything.
We'll be back before dusk.
You couldn't see anything in the twilight.

note: singular, masculine: у сумраку - at dusk

examples.en: Your message worried me.
Mom got worried when he didn't call.
The police identified the suspect.
Can you identify this man?
It was a terrible sight.
What a wonderful sight!
Her testimony is key to the case.
The judge heard the witness's testimony.
I'm tired of waiting.
When he gets fed up, he'll leave.

note: impersonal + dat.: досадило ми је - I'm fed up

examples.en: The general ordered a retreat.
We demand the withdrawal of the troops.
Leave a message with my secretary.
He is the party's general secretary.
I'm taking my final exams this year.
At the prom we danced all night.
A rainbow appeared after the rain.
A rainbow has seven colors.
The doctor says you need to rest.
On weekends I rest at home.

tips: In the sense «to rest» the verb is reflexive: «одмарам се», not «одмарам».

forms: кајем се, кају се; pf. покајати се

examples.en: I don't regret anything.

examples.sr: [Ка̏је] се што јој је то рекао.
examples.en: He regrets having told her that.

tips: Покајати се - to regret, to repent (once): «Нећеш се покајати» - you won't regret it. Кајати се - to feel remorse for a long time.

examples.en: The village priest baptized the child.
She listens to pop and rock.

examples.sr: Село је двадесет километара [ју̏жно] од Београда.
examples.en: The village is twenty kilometers south of Belgrade.
The plain begins south of the river.
My son-in-law works as a doctor.
The mother-in-law likes her son-in-law.

examples.sr: На [ска̏ли] од један до десет, колико боли?
examples.en: On a scale of one to ten, how much does it hurt?

examples.sr: Земљотрес је био пет степени по Рихтеровој [ска̏ли].
examples.en: The earthquake measured five on the Richter scale.
He asked the police for help.
We must demand an explanation.

examples.sr: Нико те не може [прѝсилити] на то.
examples.en: Nobody can force you to do that.
They forced him to sign.
Her husband is very witty.

examples.sr: Написала је [духо̀виту] причу о свом детињству.
examples.en: She wrote a witty story about her childhood.

tips: Means witty, quick-minded; said of a person, a joke, a remark. Not «spiritual» (that is духован / духовни).

examples.en: This noise is driving me crazy.
Stop driving me crazy!
We spent a pleasant evening.
This armchair is very comfortable.
This summer I'm doing an internship at a bank.
Theory and practice are not the same.
Why do you keep accusing me?
He is accused of theft.
She is a very talented singer.
He's talented, but lazy.
Will you testify in court?
This testifies to his courage.
The teacher constantly stresses the importance of reading.
The application deadline expires on Friday.
On weekends we go on an outing.
The school is organizing a trip to Fruška Gora.

tips: Факултативни излет - an optional excursion for an extra fee. «Одлазак до манастира» - a trip to a monastery.

examples.en: The company commander issued an order.
The whole company went into the attack.
What are you staring at me for?
He stares at his phone all day.

meanings: to spread out, to open wide

examples.en: Spread your arms and close your eyes.
Rumors spread quickly.
I'll pay you double.
Now I work twice as much.
Our godfather sponsored our son's baptism.

examples.sr: Ко ће ти бити [ку̑м] на венчању?
examples.en: Who will be your best man at the wedding?

related.en: the bond between godparents and family

note: кум is both a godfather and the best man at a wedding
tips: Two roles: венчани кум - the wedding witness (best man), крштени кум - the godfather at a baptism. One person often fills both. Saying: «Кум није дугме» - a кум is no trifle, but almost family.
At a wedding the кум is the witness and a guest of honor on the groom's side (often also the godfather). «Стари сват» - the groom's chief guest, девер - the groom's brother.

examples.en: She likes to read poetry.

examples.sr: Ово није музика, ово је права [по̀е̄зија]!
examples.en: This isn't music, this is real poetry!
A telegram arrived from London.
I sent her a telegram for her birthday.
On weekends we have a barbecue in the yard.
We ordered a mixed grill for two.

tips: The stress is on the first syllable: «ро̀штиљ», not on the last. The same in «роштиљати» (to grill).

examples.en: After work I need a massage.
She goes for a massage once a week.
Thank you for your kindness.
Her kindness knows no bounds.
Her face gives away her fear.
People are paying tribute to the dead.
This is my fiancé Marko.
Her fiancé lives in Germany.

note: a fiancé until the wedding; at the wedding he is the младожења (groom)

forms: оштетим, оштете; past part. оштећен; impf. оштећивати

examples.en: The storm damaged the roof.
The car was badly damaged in the accident.
I left my purse in the taxi.
My wallet is in my bag.
Be sure to call me when you arrive.
Come tomorrow, without fail!
The team fought fiercely to the end.
Last night we had an awesome time.

note: colloquially also «awesomely»: жестоко смо се провели

examples.en: What's for dessert?
I didn't order dessert, I'm full.
Grandma keeps her crystal in the display cabinet.
The water is clear as crystal.
You scared me!
The child was completely terrified.

meanings: mister, uncle (an adult man, said by children)

examples.sr: [Чи̏ка] из продавнице ми је дао бомбону.
examples.en: The man from the shop gave me a candy.
Ask that man where the stop is.

note: how children address an unfamiliar man

examples.en: It doesn't matter who is to blame.
What did he say? - Never mind.
He served in an infantry regiment.
The regiment commander arrived this morning.
She has big brown eyes.
I bought brown shoes.

note: indeclinable: браон ципеле, у браон капути
tips: Indeclinable: «браон ципеле», «браон боје». So are розе, лила, беж, тегет and the colloquial кул, екстра.
Indeclinable, like беж, тегет, каки, окер: браон ципеле, у браон ципелама. What color? - Које боје?

examples.en: I have a dentist appointment on Friday.
I didn't understand that technical term.

tips: At a clinic термин is the appointment time: «закажати термин», «Имате ли слободан термин?». Also a time in the sense of a date or deadline.
At a practice термин also means an open slot: има слободне термине сутра преподне/поподне - there are free slots tomorrow morning/afternoon. Не одговара ми овај термин - this time doesn't suit me.

examples.en: He works for a large corporation.
Corporations control the market.
That's small consolation to me.
She sought comfort in music.
I spoke with a representative of the company.
He is our representative on the board.

examples.sr: Само [о̀пуштено], све ће бити у реду.
examples.en: Just relax, everything will be fine.
We chatted casually, like old friends.

note: colloquial «само опуштено» - relax, take it easy
tips: As a reply to a problem: «Опуштено, наћи ћеш бољег» - don't worry, you'll find someone better. «Опуштено» means calmly, no panic.

examples.en: The commander ordered a retreat.
Report to the commander!
He sacrificed his life for a friend.
I don't want to sacrifice my career.
I'm afraid of flying.
As a boy he dreamed of flying.
Grandpa has a big mustache.
The cat has long whiskers.

tips: A mustache is usually plural: «брци» or «бркови» (gen. бркова): «Има велике бркове». The singular «брк» - a single mustache hair - is rarely used in practice.

examples.en: I parked in the underground garage.
There is an underground passage under the street.
I forgot my password.
What's the Wi-Fi password?
He earns a thousand euros a month.
We pay the rent monthly.
You look wonderful!
It's amazing that you survived.
The wedding is in October.
The first rains arrive at the beginning of October.

tips: The fleeting «а» drops in declension: октобар, but у октобру, средином октобра.

examples.sr: Морам да одем у [амба̀саду] по визу.
examples.en: I have to go to the embassy for a visa.
There is a long line in front of the embassy.
She ordered a fruit cocktail.
We were invited to a reception at the embassy.
Thank you for your cooperation.
The two companies have started cooperating.
He took the oath before the court.
You broke your vow!

note: not to be confused with клетва - a curse

examples.en: We must follow the protocol.
That's the procedure at the hospital.
The doctor is not available until Monday.
The service is available to everyone.
You are my salvation.
There is no salvation for him anymore.
My daughter gave me one of her drawings.
The walls are covered with children's drawings.
He has great standing in the town.
This will ruin my reputation.
The rebels took the city.
Even in school he was a rebel.
Grandma fries in pork lard.
Rub this ointment on the wound.
The bridge is made of steel.
Steel is heavy and strong.
Don't talk like that, it's rude.
Roughly speaking, it's a fraud.
He does a very important job.
We do all the housework ourselves.
The peasant is riding a donkey.
You're as stubborn as a mule!

tips: A symbol of stupidity and stubbornness: «глуп као магарац», «тврдоглав као магарац». Vocative: магарче.
Used in direct address: «Магарче један!», «Коњу један!», «Мајмуне!» (vocative). About someone: «он је магарац».

examples.en: Economic growth has slowed.
Children need sleep for growth.
The street is very narrow.
These pants are tight on me.
The ring is made of silver.
Our national team won silver.
She has a nice figure.
The chess pieces are wooden.
You'll regret this!
I've never regretted coming.

related.en: to regret, to feel sorry for

examples.en: We loaded our things into the pickup.
He drove an old white pickup.
He studies at the law school.
I need legal advice.
Tea with lemon, please.
Squeeze half a lemon into the salad.
Add these two numbers.
Pull yourself together, everyone is looking at you!

forms: одвија се, одвијају се; pf. одвити се

examples.en: The film is set in Paris.
Everything is going according to plan.
The book is on the top shelf.
We live on the top floor.
Where did you park the car?
You're not allowed to park here.
The police are still looking for the culprit.
Who is to blame for this?
I heard a shot and ran.
Shots could be heard at night.
The producer is not happy with the film.
He works as a music producer.
Don't exaggerate, it wasn't that bad.
I think you're overdoing it a bit.

examples.sr: Мама ми је читала [ба̏јке] пред спавање.
examples.en: Mom read me fairy tales before bed.
Life is not a fairy tale.
What's playing at the cinema?
The painting depicts an old village house.
Don't be shy, come in!
She is a quiet and shy girl.
He hit the target with an arrow.
The arrow points the way to the exit.
I felt awkward asking.
It's an inconvenient time to talk right now.

meanings: to set in, to come (of a season, a period)

examples.en: The band is playing at the club tonight.
He is performing in front of a large audience for the first time.

Every person has the right to dignity.
We bought a plot of land by the river.
This soil is very fertile.
We're going on vacation in August.
At the end of August we go back home.
We have to clarify this matter.
I'd like to clear up a misunderstanding.
The king and queen live at court.
We visited the White Palace in Belgrade.

note: the yard of a house is двориште
